children: Monte Rosa received a $50 million milestone payment after Novartis initiated a Phase 2 study of MRT-6160 (DDY391) in Sjögren’s disease.
Novartis has initiated a randomized Phase 2a/b trial of MRT-6160 (DDY391) in participants with Sjögren’s disease.
The Phase 2 study is global, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled and will evaluate up to 52 weeks of treatment.
Initiation of the Phase 2 study triggered a $50 million milestone payment to Monte Rosa from Novartis.
Under the Novartis agreement Monte Rosa is eligible for up to $2.1 billion in development, regulatory, and sales milestones beginning with Phase 2 starts.
Novartis holds exclusive worldwide rights to develop, manufacture and commercialize VAV1-directed MGDs; Monte Rosa may co-fund Phase 3 and share U.S. profits and receive ex-U.S. royalties.
